title: Monitor CPU and power usage with powermetrics
summary: Use the powermetrics command to see detailed statistics about CPU usage, power consumption, and system wakeups. This tool is primarily for developers or advanced users diagnosing performance issues.

steps.explain: Run powermetrics with sudo to gather and display CPU, power, and wakeup metrics. By default, it samples every 5 seconds.
steps.expect: A continuous stream of text showing CPU frequency, power usage, and process lists.
